verdict.rationale: Reflect's own site explicitly states notes are end-to-end encrypted so 'no one else can read them (not even us)' and that it syncs notes instantly across devices, directly matching the story. However, community discussion reveals a caveat: Reflect's own security page admits files/images attached to notes are NOT end-to-end encrypted, only note text, so the encryption guarantee is narrower than a blanket claim. Missing for 10: independent security audit results, and clarity that binary attachments are excluded from E2EE.
